name: io.github.mikusnuz/umami
description: MCP server for Umami Analytics v3 — analytics, boards, links, pixels, reports, replay, and more

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_MODE
environmentVariables.description: Optional 'self-hosted' or 'cloud' override; otherwise inferred from UMAMI_URL

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_URL
environmentVariables.description: Self-hosted Umami instance URL; optional for Cloud API keys

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_COLLECTOR_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional collection host for send, batch, heartbeat, share, and recorder calls

environmentVariables.name: UMAMI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Bearer API key for Umami Cloud or self-hosted Umami 3.4+
